definition: I. [ פָּרַשׁ ] verb make distinct, declare (Late Hebrew seperate oneself , Pi`el separate, explain , so Aramaic פְּרַשׁ especially Pa`el; Syriac separate, distinguish, explain , compare Mandean, Nö M 221 ); — Qal Infinitive construct ׳ לִפְרשׁ לָהֶם עַלפִּֿי י Lev 24:12 ( P ) to declare distinctly to them . Niph`al Participle נִפְרָשׁוֺת Ezek 34:12 read probably שׂוֺת -, see פרשׂ . Pu`al Perfect 3 masculine singular פֹּרַשׁ Num 15:34 ( P ) what should be done to him had not been distinctly declared; Participle מְפֹרָשׁ Neh 8:8 made distinct (compare B Aram Ezra 4:18 ), see BeRy Kö Einl. 99, > interpreted , Ke and others, Berliner T. Onk ii.74 .
